name: ai-crossborder-pro
description: AI Cross-Border E-Commerce Automation Workflow — Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be,el "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/frontend && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac --project packages/electron
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --x64 --project packages/electron
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npx electron-builder --linux --project packages/electron
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/frontend/dist packages/backend/dist packages/electron/dist-electron packages/electron/frontend-dist packages/electron/backend-dist packages/electron/backend_dist_node_modules packages/electron/release
